overall_reason: The page holds a strict warm monochrome: an off-white paper (#f9f9f8 rendered), a warm near-black ink lab(1.55 0.64 1.00) used for text, buttons and one inverse band, a warm grey lab(36 3.5 6.8) for body, and hairlines in ink at 10% alpha. No accent competes with the black actions, and the only hue is a green status dot, but nothing on the page (the wordmark is plain text) traces the warm tint to a brand.

score.reason: T-NEUTRALS, T-ACCENT-DOSAGE and T-GRAYSCALE pass (one warm temperature, no accent, black actions survive grayscale); T-PALETTE-ROLES finds five white alpha levels on the dark band and T-LINE-DELETION finds boxes and rules that separate nothing; T-COLOUR-SOURCE has no brand to confirm the palette.

findings.title: Regions use the lowest rung of the surface ladder
findings.where: integrations marquee, metrics grid and feature rows, 1440, tiles/1440-06.png, tiles/1440-05.png, tiles/1440-02.png
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json gives 73 elements a border in ink at 10% alpha (oklab(0.12 0.005 0.009 / 0.1)). Hiding them: the 18 integration chips ("Stripe Payments", "Redis Cache") lose nothing, since each is a name and a caption with whitespace around it; the feature rows 01 to 04 are already separated by 300px of space and their numbers; the full-width rules above and below the logo strip and the metrics section double the section spacing.
findings.before: Hairline boxes on every integration chip plus a rule between every section and every feature row
findings.after: Whitespace as the separator for the chips and sections; keep the hairline only on the code panel, the pricing columns and the metrics grid, where it groups figures
findings.why: With every block outlined, the outlines stop signalling which things belong together.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.evidence: On the dark band dom-1440.json sets text in the paper colour at full strength (12 elements) and at 0.6, 0.5, 0.4 and 0.3 alpha (9 elements): five levels on one ground. The inactive steps "Build your workflow" and "Ship to production" use the faintest, and the sweep's A11-001 hit on the step numeral "II" (1.30:1) lands on the same alpha.
findings.before: Five alpha steps of white text on the dark band
findings.after: Three levels on the inverse ground (primary, secondary, muted) matched to the three on the light paper
findings.why: Alpha steps 0.1 apart are not readable as distinct roles, and the faintest ones carry real content.

strengths: One warm temperature throughout: ink, body grey and hairlines are all tinted to the same warm hue, and the inverse band uses a warm black #0a0705 rather than a cool slate.
No accent: the primary actions ("Start free trial", "Start trial", "Start building free") are the ink colour and stay the strongest marks in the grayscale fold (03-lenses/color/gray-fold-1440.png).
Two grounds only (paper and one inverse band); depth comes from no shadows (one inert recipe) and one flat code panel.
The single chromatic colour is a green status dot on "Live" and "Ready", one state in one role.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page is light and no dark theme was captured; the stylesheet has a dark class variant that was not rendered.
The palette table could not read colours written as lab() and oklab(), so text levels and accent groups were read from the computed styles in dom-1440.json instead.
T-COLOUR-SOURCE: no brand authority was supplied and the wordmark carries no colour, so the warm monochrome cannot be traced to a source; it is not a framework default either.
